# fastly_service_response_object (List Resource)

List all response objects across all Fastly CDN services at their active version, or latest version when no active version exists.



## Schema

### Optional

- `service_id` (String) Optional Fastly service ID to restrict discovery to a single service. When omitted, all services accessible to the API token are considered.
